reviews.shade: COSRX Aloe 54.2 Aqua Tone-Up Sunscreen SPF50+
reviews.text: I used to apply only my cushion foundation which comes with a bit SPF, but that apparently is not enough to protect me from the UV lights! That’s why I get this for my dry skin and hoping it helps calming and anti-aging from UV lights.
reviews.zh: 以前我淨係用氣墊粉底，雖然有少少 SPF，但明顯係唔夠保護我對抗 UV！正因如此我先買咗呢支畀我嘅乾性肌，希望可以幫助舒緩同抗 UV 老化。

reviews.shade: COSRX Aloe 54.2 Aqua Tone-Up Sunscreen SPF50+
reviews.text: Just seems ‘eh’. Leaves a weird, salmon-coloured cast. Not sheet white but not a flattering shade. It also smells very chemical like to me which I do not care for.
reviews.zh: 感覺只係『啱啱好』。留低一種怪怪嘅、似三文魚色嘅泛白。唔係死白但又唔係好睇嘅色調。對我嚟講味道亦非常化學感，我唔受落。

reviews.shade: COSRX Aloe 54.2 Aqua Tone-Up Sunscreen SPF50+
reviews.text: I tend to mix this with another sunscreen as the brightening sometimes is a little too much if I'm quite tanned. Perfectly brightens my skin. Highly recommend
reviews.zh: 我通常會將呢支同另一支防曬溝住用，因為如果我曬得比較黑，個提亮效果有時會太強。提亮膚色效果完美。非常推薦

reviews.shade: COSRX Aloe 54.2 Aqua Tone-Up Sunscreen SPF50+
reviews.text: The SPF is better for those with more pale skin. Because I am on the medium-tan side, it pulled a little bit grey on my skin. However, in terms of sun protection and texture, it was absolutely amazing.
reviews.zh: 呢支 SPF 比較啱皮膚較白嘅人。因為我膚色屬於中等偏深，上面之後有少少偏灰。不過喺防曬效果同質地方面，絕對係一流。

reviews.shade: COSRX Aloe 54.2 Aqua Tone-Up Sunscreen SPF50+
reviews.text: Really loving this sunscreen! The COSRX Aloe Aqua Tone-Up gives my skin a fresh, hydrated feel with a subtle brightening effect—perfect for no-makeup days. It’s lightweight, blends well, and doesn’t feel greasy at all. I took off one star because it can leave a slight white cast if I use too much, but once it settles, it looks great. Bonus: my skin stays calm thanks to the aloe. Definitely one of my go-to SPFs for a glowy, even look!
reviews.zh: 真係好鍾意呢枝防曬！COSRX Aloe Aqua Tone-Up 畀我皮膚一種清新、保濕嘅感覺，仲有少少提亮效果——素顏日必備。質地輕盈，容易推開，完全唔會油笠。我扣咗一星係因為用太多嘅話會有少少泛白，但等佢settle好之後就好靚。加分位：多謝蘆薈令到我皮膚keep住穩定。絕對係我日常用嘅防曬之一，搵到水光、均勻嘅膚況！

reviews.shade: COSRX Aloe 54.2 Aqua Tone-Up Sunscreen SPF50+
reviews.text: This is a great sunscreen as a stand alone product BUT I do not like it with my makeup because I have experienced this sunscreen peeling after some time especially after a workout or being out in the heat. I do not use this as my everyday sunscreen but I do like putting it on, on my no makeup days because it has a slight tint.
reviews.zh: 單獨用嘅話呢枝防曬係好好嘅，但我唔鍾意配搭化妝用，因為試過過咗一段時間之後，尤其係做完運動或者出咗街好熱，呢枝防曬會甩膜。所以我唔係日日都用佢，不過素顏日我會搽，因為佢有少少調色效果。

reviews.shade: COSRX Aloe 54.2 Aqua Tone-Up Sunscreen SPF50+
reviews.text:
Cumple su función!! Es bastante ligero y apesar de ser un bloqueador tone up, no te deja rosa o muy pálida, al momento te deja un acabado bonito!
Sin embargo creo es más para pieles secas, la mía es mixta y después de un tiempo se pone muy grasosa...no es malo pero algo a tener en cuenta. 
En lo personal me gusto más que la versión original de áloe vera de cosrx.
reviews.zh:
做到佢嘅功效！！質地幾輕，雖然係一支tone up防曬，但唔會令你變粉紅或者太蒼白，一搽完即刻就有個幾靚嘅妝效！
不過我覺得佢比較適合乾性肌，我自己係混合性，用咗一陣之後會變得好油…唔係差嘅，但呢點要留意。
個人嚟講我覺得比cosrx原版嘅蘆薈嗰支好用。

reviews.shade: COSRX Aloe 54.2 Aqua Tone-Up Sunscreen SPF50+
reviews.text: I loved Cosrx original aloe sunscreen. This one has a bit more sunscreen-ish scent I’d say but not extreme so I have no problem using it. I don’t wear sunscreen so I was looking for tinted sunscreen. Great option for those who don’t wear sunscreen but want a bit more coverage and also for those who wants to re-apply sunscreen. As far as the coverage, it’s not gonna be like concealer but I had a obvious pigmentation on my chin and it looked a lot less obvious. It’s able to tone it out overall. I have experienced a little bit irritation but maybe bc I’m going through some rush on my face lately.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意Cosrx原版嘅蘆薈防曬。呢支嘅防曬味就再多少少，但唔算好勁，所以我冇問題用得落。我平時唔搽防曬，所以想搵有調色效果嘅防曬。對嗰啲唔搽防曬但想要多啲遮瑕嘅人嚟講係個好選擇，對想補搽防曬嘅人都啱用。講到遮瑕度，佢唔會似遮瑕膏咁強，但我下巴有個明顯嘅色素沉積，用完之後望落淡咗好多。整體可以調整到膚色。我試過有少少刺激感，但可能係因為我塊面最近生緊嘢。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
